---
title: "Choosing questions for your survey"
description: "Choose a question type to match the information you need, from agreement ratings and dates to written feedback and ranked options, with the analyses each type suits."
---

Choose a question type to match the information you need, from agreement
ratings and dates to written feedback and ranked options. Each type below
links to a page that shows how to add it. The `input_types` demo holds all
13: open it from RStudio's Addins menu with **surveyframe: Try a demo**.

## Questions, response options and scales

A **question** asks 1 thing. Its **response options** are the labelled
choices it offers, such as Strongly disagree to Strongly agree, and related
questions can share 1 set of options. A **scored scale** combines a group of
related questions into 1 score, such as an organisation score from 4
agreement questions, and its reliability is checked as a whole.
[Add a Likert question to a scale](../docs/question-types/likert.html) shows
the steps.

## The 13 question types

| Type | What the respondent does | Suits |
|---|---|---|
| [Likert](../docs/question-types/likert.html) | Rates agreement on a labelled scale | Scored scales, reliability, ordinal tests |
| [Single choice](../docs/question-types/single-choice.html) | Picks 1 option | Frequencies, cross-tabulations, group comparisons |
| [Multiple choice](../docs/question-types/multiple-choice.html) | Picks any options | Frequencies, Cochran's Q |
| [Numeric](../docs/question-types/numeric.html) | Types a number | Descriptives, t-tests, regression |
| [Short text](../docs/question-types/short-text.html) | Types a line | Text analysis |
| [Long text](../docs/question-types/long-text.html) | Types a paragraph | Text analysis, topic models |
| [Date](../docs/question-types/date.html) | Picks a date | Descriptives |
| [Grid (matrix)](../docs/question-types/grid.html) | Rates a set of rows on 1 scale | Descriptives, scored scales |
| [Slider](../docs/question-types/slider.html) | Drags to a value | Descriptives, correlation |
| [Ranking](../docs/question-types/ranking.html) | Orders options | Rank descriptives |
| [Star rating](../docs/question-types/star-rating.html) | Gives stars | Descriptives, ordinal tests |
| [Pairwise comparison](../docs/question-types/pairwise-comparison.html) | Judges which of 2 criteria matters more (Saaty), or how much 1 influences another (0 to 4) | AHP, ANP, DEMATEL |
| [Criteria weights](../docs/question-types/criteria-weights.html) | Divides 100 points across criteria | Decision methods |

The 2 layout elements are a **section break**, which starts a new page with
a heading, and a **text block**, which shows text and collects no answer.

Any question can be **required**, shown only when an earlier answer allows it
(**branching**), or checked for attention (**attention checks**).

## For analysis: how answers are stored

Each type stores its answer in a declared shape, so the analysis plan matches
each method to the answers it can use. Likert, single choice, slider, star
rating and numeric questions store 1 value. A multiple choice question stores
1 column per option, a grid 1 column per row, a pairwise comparison 1 column
per pair compared, and criteria weights 1 column per criterion. Text and date
questions store the text or date given, and a ranking stores the order.
